series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2018, digital business will require 50 percent less business process workers and 500 percent more key digital business jobs, compared with traditional models.
entries.subject: Digital business workforce
entries.metric: change in business process workers / key digital business jobs

entries.quote: By year-end 2016, 50 percent of digital transformation initiatives will be unmanageable due to lack of portfolio management skills, leading to a measurable negative lost market share.
entries.subject: Digital transformation portfolio management
entries.metric: share of digital transformation initiatives unmanageable

entries.quote: By 2017, a significant disruptive digital business will be launched that was conceived by a computer algorithm.
entries.subject: Algorithm-conceived business

entries.quote: Through 2015, the most highly valued initial public offerings (IPOs) will involve companies that combine digital markets with physical logistics to challenge pure physical legacy business ecosystems.
entries.subject: IPOs combining digital and physical logistics

entries.quote: By 2018, the total cost of ownership for business operations will be reduced by 30 percent through smart machines and industrialized services.
entries.subject: Smart machines and industrialized services
entries.metric: reduction in total cost of ownership for business operations

entries.quote: By 2015, there will be more than 40 vendors with commercially available managed services offerings leveraging smart machines and industrialized services.
entries.subject: Managed services using smart machines

entries.quote: By 2020, developed world life expectancy will increase by 0.5 years due to widespread adoption of wireless health monitoring technology.
entries.subject: Wireless health monitoring and life expectancy
entries.metric: increase in developed world life expectancy

entries.quote: By 2017, costs for diabetic care are reduced by 10 percent through the use of smartphones.
entries.subject: Smartphones in diabetic care

entries.quote: By year-end 2016, more than $2 billion in online shopping will be performed exclusively by mobile digital assistants.
entries.subject: Mobile digital assistants in shopping
entries.metric: online shopping performed exclusively by mobile digital assistants

entries.quote: By year-end 2015, mobile digital assistants will have taken on tactical mundane processes such as filling out names, addresses and credit card information.
entries.subject: Mobile digital assistants for mundane tasks

entries.quote: By 2017, U.S. customers' mobile engagement behavior will drive mobile commerce revenue in the U.S. to 50 percent of U.S. digital commerce revenue.
entries.subject: U.S. mobile commerce
entries.metric: share of U.S. digital commerce revenue from mobile

entries.quote: A renewed interest in mobile payment will arise in 2015, together with a significant increase in mobile commerce (due in part to the introduction of Apple Pay and similar efforts by competitors, such as Google increasing efforts to drive adoption of its NFC-enabled Google Wallet).
entries.subject: Mobile payment

entries.quote: By 2017, 70 percent of successful digital business models will rely on deliberately unstable processes designed to shift as customer needs shift.
entries.subject: Deliberately unstable business processes
entries.metric: share of successful digital business models relying on unstable processes

entries.quote: By the end of 2015, five percent of global organizations will design "supermaneuverable" processes that provide competitive advantage.
entries.subject: Supermaneuverable processes
entries.metric: share of global organizations designing supermaneuverable processes

entries.quote: By 2017, 50 percent of consumer product investments will be redirected to customer experience innovations.
entries.subject: Customer experience investment
entries.metric: share of consumer product investments redirected to customer experience

entries.quote: By 2015, more than half of traditional consumer products will have native digital extensions.
entries.subject: Digital extensions of consumer products
entries.metric: share of traditional consumer products with native digital extensions

entries.quote: By 2017, nearly 20 percent of durable goods e-tailers will use 3D printing (3DP) to create personalized product offerings.
entries.subject: 3D printing for personalized products
entries.metric: share of durable goods e-tailers using 3D printing

entries.quote: By 2015, more than 90 percent of durable goods e-tailers will actively seek external partnerships to support the new "personalized" product business models.
entries.subject: E-tailer partnerships for personalization
entries.metric: share of durable goods e-tailers seeking external partnerships

entries.quote: By 2020, retail businesses that utilize targeted messaging in combination with internal positioning systems (IPS) will see a five percent increase in sales.
entries.subject: Indoor positioning and retail sales

entries.quote: By 2016, there will be an increase in the number of offers from retailers focused on customer location and the length of time in store.
entries.subject: Location-based retail offers
